mapper.select: SELECT MEET_ID AS meetId , MEET_TITLE AS meetTitle , DATE_FORMAT(MEET_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS meetDt , CONTENT_FULL AS contentFull , CONTENT_SUM AS contentSum , ACTION_ITEMS AS actionItems , ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId FROM TB_MEETING WHERE MEET_ID = #{meetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LOG ( PROJ_ID, REF_ID, FILE_ID, AI_CATEGORY, INPUT_DATA, OUTPUT_DATA, REASONING, CONFIDENCE_INDEX, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{projId}, #{refId}, #{fileId}, #{aiCategory}, #{inputData}, #{outputData}, #{reasoning}, #{confidenceIndex}, #{lastUpdusrId}, NOW() )
